task_info.problem_statement:
# [bug, dbg] Don't cache instruction whilst in debug mode lowrisc/ibex#1472

CHERIoT Ibex does not disable the instruction cache when in debug mode, leading to incorrect behaviour. This was previously discovered and fixed in upstream Ibex in 2021-2022.

See [lowRISC Ibex issue 1472](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/issues/1472) for details on the problem and [lowRISC Ibex commit 7b1be33](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/commit/7b1be3354d650bc5b23dff6f439459c353288e4f) for the fix implemented.
